## Stop Copying Numbers by Hand

PDF tables are everywhere. Invoices, reports, financial statements. Getting that data into Excel always meant one thing: retype every row by hand.

That's the old way.

[FileTools.eu](https://filetools.eu/pdf-to-excel) converts PDF tables to Excel in seconds. Upload a PDF, wait a few moments, download a working .xlsx file. No formatting lost, no data corrupted.

## How It Works

The engine reads the PDF, identifies table structures, and maps them to Excel cells. Columns stay columns. Headers stay headers. Numbers stay numbers.

Here's what it handles well:

- **Multi-page tables** — splits them cleanly across sheets or keeps them continuous
- **Merged cells** — detects them and preserves the structure
- **Scanned PDFs** — uses OCR to read text from image-based PDFs
- **Mixed content** — PDFs with text and tables on the same page

## When You'd Use This

**Accounting.** Client sends a PDF invoice. You need the line items in your spreadsheet. One upload, done.

**Research.** PDF report with data tables. Pull the numbers without touching a keyboard.

**E-commerce.** Supplier catalogs in PDF format. Convert product listings to Excel for inventory management.

**Real estate.** Property listings, comparables, market reports — all in PDFs. Extract the data you need.

## Why Not a Converter Crappy Converter Site?

Because most PDF-to-Excel converters are either:

- Upload to some server, wait for an email link
- Pay per file
- Limited to 3 pages
- Reformat your data

FileTools does none of that. Everything runs locally in your browser. The file never leaves your machine. No upload to a server somewhere. No waiting for emails.

It's also completely free. No credits, no trial period, no "upgrade to export."

## FileTools Also Does

FileTools isn't just PDF-to-Excel. It converts between 40+ formats: [images to PDF](https://filetools.eu/jpg-to-pdf), Word documents, presentations, ebooks. All with the same privacy-first approach.

Need to [merge PDFs](https://filetools.eu/merge-pdfs)? Split them? Compress them? Unlock a protected document? Same tool, same privacy.

## The Bottom Line

If you're still retyping PDF tables into Excel, you're wasting time. FileTools does it in seconds. Free, private, no sign-up.

Stop copying. Start converting.
